programme.title: The FBI Files: The Search For Lisa Rene
programme.desc: When a young woman was grabbed from her Texas home, the police raced to find her abductors. On the face of it, the kidnapping seemed like the random act of desperate men.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hidden Agenda
programme.desc: Across the Midwest, a band of armed robbers struck banks at the rate of nearly one per month. They attacked with lightning precision and lethal force. They were in and out in five minutes.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Small Town Terror
programme.desc: In a small Ohio community, an elderly woman and a teenaged boy disappeared. Because they vanished within hours of each other, police believed the cases were linked. But they didn't know how.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Family Torn
programme.desc: The parents of 11 yr. old Brittany Martinez knew their daughter was no runaway. Something had happened to her, something terrible. When they failed to find Brittany in their quiet Illinois neighborhood, they called the police.

programme.title: The Way Back

programme.title: The Fountain

programme.title: Wild Target

programme.title: The Female Brain

programme.title: Forensic Files: Scratching The Surface
programme.desc: The only clue recovered from a shooting is a twelve-guage shotgun. Scientists use unique methods to lift the serial number from the weapon to trace it to its owner

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fire Proof
programme.desc: A serial arsonist starts several fires that cause millions of dollars worth of damage and the deaths of three people. He is discovered, partly through the use of forensic hypnosis.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Breaking the Mold
programme.desc: A three-year-old develops a respiratory condition. His father has Alzheimers. An investigator reveals that their ill health is due to mold in their modern home.

programme.title: Forensic Files: House Call
programme.desc: A murder investigation in Florida crosses jurisdictions from New York and Jamaica. The police rely on cell phone mapping, wiretapping and a host of forensic evidence to link a suspect to a murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Plastic Fire
programme.desc: A woman convicted of killing her mother in a car fire is granted a new trial. An expert witness has a different opinion as to how the fire started and, if proven, would clear the woman of any culpability.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Last Will
programme.desc: Authorities track a kidnapper who let his victim write a last will and informed the family of her murder. A phone number written on a previous page left a lasting impression, which helped to convict.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dessert Served Cold
programme.desc: A man dies in his home after a long history of heart disease. A few weeks after the funeral, rumors surface that the death was no accident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Music Case
programme.desc: In 1999, a 12-year-old was found murdered in her Minnesota home. Despite a meticulous search of the home and an exhaustive investigation, police had no suspects.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Paintball
programme.desc: In 1962, the small town residents of Hanford, California lost their sense of peace when one of their own, 15-year-old Marlene Miller, was murdered.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sign Here
programme.desc: A mother of two vanishes after a shopping trip. Her body is discovered a month later, and witnesses say they saw the victim being forced into a car by an unknown person.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Takeover
programme.desc: Two armed bank robbers hit a Seattle bank taking over 150,000 dollars. Before they can escape police confront them and the pair splits up. As authorities search block by block they learn one was a career criminal with a long history of violence.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Shattered Shield
programme.desc: In a city awash in narcotics the drug lords have all the power even over the police. Corruption in New Orleans grew like cancer, eating away at public safety and threatening to destroy the city. Crooked cops break the laws they were sworn to uphold.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Killing Zone
programme.desc: In the 1990's the war on drugs was in full swing. The front lines were often America's inner cities where gangs use violence and murder to rule their empires.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Business
programme.desc: Many escape the poverty of India to start new lives in the United States. One turned the American dream into a nightmare. People started turning up dead in New York's Indian community-authorities struggled to link fraud and murder to a powerful man.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The C-11 Squad
programme.desc: New York City is not stranger to gang violence. But when a 12-year-old child was kidnapped, the gangs had crossed a line. Law enforcement raced to find the missing boy before it was too late.

programme.title: The New Detectives: False Witness
programme.desc: When a murder is committed and deceit clouds the evidence, investigators turn to science and technology to uncover the truth and expose a murderous lie and capture the killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Face Of Tragedy
programme.desc: Forensic Sculpting: Forensic sculptors retrieve people from oblivion. Using clay and an intricate knowledge of anatomy, forensic arts place a face on an unidentified skull, recreating the victim's likeness, which often leads to his name.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner's Casebook
programme.desc: A good coroner provides what's necessary to solve a crime. A bad one can spoil an otherwise rock-solid case. Cyril Wecht and Henry Lee, two of the country's most respected coroners, share their cases and insights into crime solving.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Cold Blooded
programme.desc: Time of death is an important consideration in a murder investigation, but when a killer freezes, burns, or grinds his victim, even the most skilled medical examiner would be at a loss about how to calculate it.

programme.title: The New Detectives: To Kill Again
programme.desc: Some people do get away with murder at least for a while. Flush with their success, serial killers murder again and again. But each time they kill, they leave behind a few more clues, which ultimately lead to their capture.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Did You Fake Your Pregnancies?
programme.desc: Dennis claims his ex-girlfriend Kendal keeps tied down with pregnancy lies! He wants to know if their daughter is even his! Will Steve’s DNA test results finally let them move on?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Results Revealed: Did She Cheat?
programme.desc: Justin is convinced that girlfriend Lainie has been cheating on him, and more importantly that he’s not the father of their child. But his own insecurities have led him to turn violent. Also, Steven doubts whether Ashley’s child is his.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: A Tragic Accident
programme.desc: Rebecca left her baby with fiancé James and his mother Adeline, only to discover that her baby was hospitalized. Rebecca suspects that James is responsible. Adeline blames her for the baby’s death!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I’m Starving Myself to Death
programme.desc: Pamela aims to weigh 40 pounds. Samantha, who suffers from bulimia and alcoholism, steals to accomplish her binging. Can both women confront their eating disorders with support and treatment?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Crawl to Your Wife
programme.desc: After surviving a wild car chase, losing her leg, and being comatose due to her husband, Portia will finally confront him. He won't admit fault, but today Steve’s helping Portia find her voice.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: My Teen Daughter Wants a Baby
programme.desc: 17-year-old Naomi has undergone a sudden attitude change and is on a mission to have a baby. Parents Leeanders and April need Steve to intervene!

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Eye of the Beholder
programme.desc: Kenda encounters one of the most horrendous crime scenes of his career, but his hunt for a homicidal maniac leads him to the most unexpected of killers.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Mr. LA
programme.desc: A young man tries to flee a violent scene, but is shot dead behind the wheel of his car. A peculiar clue puts Kenda hot on the heels of a self-styled gangster with revenge on his mind.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Collision Course
programme.desc: Two best friends are gunned down on a dark residential street. When a string of disappointments threaten to derail the case, Kenda enlists the help of an old acquaintance.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Bump In the Night
programme.desc: When a pretty, young pilot is found in bed, bound and with a bullet in her head, Lt. Joe Kenda must determine if this was a random assault or payback for something that happened in the skies.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Dead Man Falling
programme.desc: When a family of four is brutally murdered, it sends a shockwave of fear through the town. Police believe they have a spree killer on their hands, until Lt. Joe Kenda discovers a gruesome connection.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Beginning of the End, Apollo Gets Complicated & The End of Apollo
programme.desc: The Beginning of the End - After the first Moon landing the Apollo science program was about to start in earnest but people were losing interest. Apollo Gets Complicated - New technology is added that extends the reach of the Apollo program.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Shuttle Program, The Challenger Disaster & Return to Space
programme.desc: The Shuttle Program - The first re-useable spacecraft. The Challenger Disaster - Pressing launch schedules lead to carelessness and the loss of the Challenger. Return to Space - A re-designed shuttle is back in space with a redefined role.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle
programme.desc: The Space Shuttle Matures - The Space Transportation System changes the nature of orbital missions. Complex Construction in Space - Confidence in the shuttle begins to return and engineers for get the lessons of the past.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Milky Way
programme.desc: This episode traces our view of the Milky Way, from the mythology of ancient sky watchers to the efforts of scientists to map it from the inside out.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Big Bang
programme.desc: Throughout history, our nightly view of the universe has fueled our collective imagination. When it comes to the Big Bang, not even the most creative work of imagination can rival what science has revealed about the birth of the universe.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Hot Zone
programme.desc: Mercury is one Earth's closest neighbors, but for centuries it eluded astronomer's best efforts to learn its secrets. But that has changed thanks to missions like Mariner and most recently, Messenger.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rays
programme.desc: Cosmic rays can tell us much about the universe. They are not simply another form of light, but carriers of information about powerful and unseen processes at work thousands or even millions of light years away.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Fermi Paradox
programme.desc: The Fermi Paradox asks the ultimate question: Given a few reasonable assumptions about the chance of life arising elsewhere in the universe and the distance between the stars, why has an alien civilization not presented itself?

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landsat
programme.desc: Take a look at Landsat 8, the advanced planetary explorer with a 900 million dollar price tag! It is designed to peer across multiple wavelengths to reveal complex and ever-changing details that are undetectable by the human eye.

programme.title: The Truth is in the Stars
programme.desc: Does our society have the capacity to live up to Star Trek's optimistic vision for humanity's future? William Shatner takes us on a journey to find out whether art has imitated life in the years since the world-renowned TV series premiered in 1966.

programme.title: Forensic Files: In Harm's Way
programme.desc: An Alaskan police officer finds a woman's body while on routine patrol of a public park. During the autopsy, the medical examiner preserves the portion of her rib cage which sustained the fatal wound.

programme.title: Forensic Files: No Corpus Delicti
programme.desc: A woman disappears without a trace. Even though foul play is suspected, the leads don't pan out and the trail turns cold. Twenty years would pass before police are able to link a clump of hair discovered in an isolated area with the missing woman.

programme.title: Forensic Files: News at 11
programme.desc: When a talented television news anchor is shot to death outside her home, it appears to be a crime of passion perpetrated by an obsessed fan.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Burning Desire
programme.desc: Investigators sift through the ashes of a fire which killed a 40-year-old woman. The fire appears to have been started by an unattended cigarette. On closer look, forensic scientists discover the cause was far more complicated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cloak of Deceit
programme.desc: For seven years, a trio of men robbed one bank after another. They always got away before the police arrived and they left no evidence behind. But the way they stood and the clothes they wore told a story that could be read by forensic scientists.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bad Medicine
programme.desc: A young woman suddenly becomes critically ill, eventually leaving her unable to walk. A bone marrow test reveals the cause: arsenic poisoning. Investigators must determine if the poisoning was caused by groundwater contamination or something sinister.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Stick 'Em Up
programme.desc: Residents of Noel, Missouri were stunned to learn that their bank had been robbed and the bank president was missing. His body was later found floating in a lake, securely bound to a chair with duct tape.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Head Games
programme.desc: A young couple decided to celebrate their first wedding anniversary with a camping trip to Mount Hood. During the trip, the husband was shot and killed. Later, his wife told two different versions of the events which led to his death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Making the Collar
programme.desc: The body of 16-year-old Leanne Tiernan was discovered nine months after she disappeared. Forensic scientists found clues that painted a virtual portrait of her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Financial Downfall

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg skylder deg en
programme.desc: Sam blir fornærmet når Freddie beskylder henne for ikke å betale ham og Carly noen av de pengene tilbake som hun konstant låner. Sam prøver iherdig å betale dem tilbake - hun finner seg en ordentlig jobb.

programme.title: iCarly: Hubert Lewbert
programme.desc: En "Lur Lewbert"-sketsj går helt galt og skader Carlys irriterende portvakt. Gjengen pleier ham inntil Freddies mor tar over. Men når kærligheten begynner å blomstre, må de sette en stopper for det.

programme.title: iCarly: Pie
programme.desc: Når Carly, Sam og Spencer tar med Freddie til deres yndlingskonditori, finner de ut at eieren er død. Men enda verre er det at oppskriftene hans kanskje er gått tapt for alltid.

programme.title: iCarly: Jul
programme.desc: I et forsøk på å pifte opp julen med et utradisjonelt tre, kommer Spencer til å sette fyr på alle Carlys gaver. Fortvilet ønsker hun seg at hun hadde en normal bror.

programme.title: iCarly: Kysset
programme.desc: Sam overhører Freddie fortelle Carly at han aldri har kysset en jente, og avslører hemmeligheten hans på netshowet. Gibby og Carly trener Spencer til utttaket for det lokale, profesjonelle fotballaget.

programme.title: iCarly: Bilbråk
programme.desc: Gjengen holder en konkurranse på iCarly, og premien er en ny bil fra en lokal forhandler. Etter at Nevel vinner, oppdager barna at forhandleren ikke visste noe om konkurransen eller bilen de skulle ha donert bort som premie.

programme.title: iCarly: Fred
programme.desc: Freddie sier offentlig at han ikke er fan av internettsensasjonen Fred, noe som får Fred til å meddele at han skal slutte å legge ut filmer for alltid. Fansen blir rasende fordi Freddie har forårsaket slutten på de populære filmene.

programme.title: iCarly: Dobbelt opp
programme.desc: Når Carly, Sam og Freddie sniker seg ut for å dra til en MMA-kamp, får de sine dobbeltgjengere til å lure Spencer til å tro at de fortsatt er hjemme. Imens bygger Spencer en kjempeversjon av Newton Balls.

programme.title: iCarly: Om hva for noe?
programme.desc: Når Carly, Sam og Freddie oppfordrer iCarly-fans til å stemme på David Archuleta i "Amerika Sings", syns de synd på nummer to og hjelper ham med å lage en musikkvideo.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg skal gjøre Sam jentete
programme.desc: Da Sam innrømmer at hun liker en gutt på skolen, lærer Carly henne hvordan hun kan lokke ham til seg ved å oppføre seg mere feminint. Spencer er overbevist om at en jente liker ham pga. smokingen hans, så han går med den hele tiden.

programme.desc: The Roast of William Shatner ble nominert til en Primetime Emmy Award i 2007, i kategorien Outstanding Variety Special. Her blir skuespilleren plassert i rampelyset når roastmaster Jason Alexander og en gruppe komikere jekker ham ned noen hakk.

programme.title: Another Period: Annulment
programme.desc: Lillian og Beatrices ekteskap blir annullert, samt Lillian og Victor krangler om deres dyrebare 'Butternut' - rommet. Beatrice hjelper Albert med å komme over øksefobien, og Garfield krangler med en tvilsom ny tjener.

programme.title: Another Period: The Prince And The Pauper
programme.desc: Huset Commodore inviterer en prins til Bellacourt Manor. Det starter en intens rivalisering mellom Lillian og Beatrice. Peepers gir prinsens tjener motbør angående korrekte butler-metoder, og Hamishs cellekamerat prøver å lære ham å lese.

programme.title: Another Period: Trial of the Century
programme.desc: Hamish står for retten for mordet på Scoops LaPue. Lillian prøver å bruke saken for å skape blest om egen person, og Peepers nyter en siste dag i frihet før han prøver å påta seg skylden for forbrytelsen.

programme.title: Detroiters: Dream Cruise
programme.desc: Når de ansatte truer med å slutte på grunn av manglende helseforsikring, forsøker Tim og Sam å samle inn pengene de skylder fra tidligere jobber. Deres innsats forvanskes av Detroits årlige 'Dream Cruise'-bilshow. Gjest er Cecily Strong.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Alien Imposters
programme.desc: Romvesener invaderer jorden, en familie forliker seg med en slektnings homobryllup og noen rasister gir uttrykk for noen overraskende meninger.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Manly Tears
programme.desc: Sketsjene inkluderer en narkohandel som går på trynet, en mafiafyr som er en stor grinasabb, og Darius Rucker som prøver å takle sin Hootie-fortid.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Gang Stand-Off
programme.desc: Sketsjene inkluderer gangstere som er gale etter 'Twilight,' besøk i en verden der navn er promper, og rasistiske superhelter.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Landlord
programme.desc: I sesongfinalen vil president Obama behandles som alle andre, Jordan ser på en leilighet som er eid av en mistenksom utleier, og et par festfiksere som vil få gang i festen på en bar mitzvah.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Killer Concept Album
programme.desc: En politiker benekter å ha sendt rampete bilder, en detektiv forhører en rapper, Cedric og Levi finner lyn i en flaske, to herrer fra sør komplimenterer kvinner, Jordan møter en gammel venn og en betjent tar tingene helt bokstavelig.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Obama Shutdown
programme.desc: Sketsjene inkluderer at Keegan blir litt for høy, en forballspiller som vil gjøre alt for å få rødt kort, og to sexeksperter som gir råd om cunnilingus.

programme.title: Key & Peele: The Branding
programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan utforsker opplevelsen som sort collegestudent og snylterne som suksess medfører. Andre sketsjer inkluderer et nabolags reaksjon på et mystisk vesen, når man kan - og ikke kan - si et kontroversielt ord.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Sex Detective
programme.desc: En respektert kriminalbetjent, ekspert i sexforbrytelser, benytter ukonvensjonelle metoder for å løse en sak, en actionhelt redder kjæresten sin og en ansatt i en butikk med yoghurt-is tester for mange vareprøver.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Meagan's Fight
programme.desc: Sketsjene inkluderer at Meagan vender tilbake, Jordan prøver å se kul ut på en strippeklubb og opptrer med et funk-show.

programme.title: Key & Peele: A Cappella Club
programme.desc: En PSA jobber med barnesoldater i Afrika, en college-a-cappella-gruppe får et nytt medlem, Meegan og André går på sin første date, en terrorgruppe har en matbil og to gamle menn diskuterer popmusikk.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Severed Head Showcase
programme.desc: En gospel-gruppe må øve uten læreren sin, en gjeng krigere feirer en halshugning, en fange prøver å narre fengselsvakten og en ung mann blir konfrontert fordi han bare snakker i floskler.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!: Episode 1720

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!: Episode 1721
programme.desc: Gjestene tror de har full kontroll på spillet etter gårsdagens hendelser. Men på seremonien venter en tvist som kan snu opp ned på alt.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!: Episode 1722
programme.desc: 90-tallet har inntatt Mexico med en legendarisk looks- og lipsync-konkurranse. En flørt fører til sjalusidrama og det eksploderer for flere av gjestene på hotellet.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!: Episode 1723

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!: Episode 1724
programme.desc: Det er klart for Pandoras eske, hvor sannheter skal frem i lyset. Stian skal velge seg en partner, og må dermed sende en annen gjest hjem.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!: Episode 1725
programme.desc: En helt absurd og sursøt uke treffer paradiset som en bombe. Røde knapper og anonyme telefoner skaper kaos på hotellet.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1004
programme.desc: Alenemoren Ragnhild og sønnen Julius sover i dag i køyeseng, og trenger desperat større plass. Christina og amerikanske Justin har mange krav på lista, og Karianne tar utfordringa på strak arm!

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1005
programme.desc: Samboerne Linn og Joakim bor i dag i drømmehuset, men det ligger på helt feil sted! Hans Christian møter Christine, som leter etter en ny leilighet med uteområde til katten sin.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1006
programme.desc: Christian skal selge leiligheten han har arvet, og Karianne får derfor en helt ny utfordring! Vi møter også tidligere deltagere og får bli med inn i deres nye leiligheter, hus og gårdsbruk.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 901
programme.desc: Toppblogger Isabel Raad har tidligere leid leilighet for 29 000 kr i måneden. Nå skal hun kjøpe sin aller første bolig, men klarer Karianne å finne noe som kan leve opp til de skyhøye forventningene?

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 902
programme.desc: Amalie Snøløs drømmer om å kjøpe et oppussingsobjekt! Men har hun egentlig tid til det? Solfrid og André har spurt Hans Christian om hjelp til å finne drømmehuset, men ikke for enhver pris.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 623

programme.desc: A mother of two vanishes after a shopping trip. Her body is discovered a month later, and witnesses say they saw the victim being forced into a car by an unknown person.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shadow of a Doubt
programme.desc: A woman is shot to death in her store just one day before she is to testify against the man accused of robbing her. The robber becomes the prime suspect, but he has a solid alibi: a timestamped videotape of his activities on the day of the murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tourist Trap
programme.desc: In 1993, the state of Florida was known for more than just Disney World. Worldwide attention focused on a rash of robberies which targeted tourists. Some vacationers were killed in these attacks, but some fought and survived.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Once Bitten
programme.desc: Investigators find a shoe print, several foreign hairs and unknown fingerprints at a murder scene. But they believe the most telling piece of evidence is the bite mark on the victim's chest.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All Wet
programme.desc: A woman's death in Pennsylvania triggers a homicide investigation into another woman's death in North Carolina. Faced with striking similarities, examiners must determine if their suspect's story about accidental drowning is all wet.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shot of Vengeance
programme.desc: A 34-year-old nurse experiences a variety of flu-like symptoms. None of her doctors are able to discover the cause, until she visits her gynecologist for a routine check-up.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dinner and a Movie
programme.desc: Time of death becomes pivotal after a pregnant woman is found murdered in her air-conditioned bedroom. A striking similarity between her death and an HBO movie gives examiners the clues they need to thaw out the alibi of a cold-blooded killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Wrong Foot
programme.desc: Police were puzzled by an obscure print found at a crime scene where one man had been killed and two teenage girls were seriously injured. Neither of the girls could identify their attacker, but one simple clue helped track the footsteps of a killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Order Up
programme.desc: A man is found dead in his home and his ex-wife has a perfect alibi. To determine time of death, investigators need to know when the victim ate his last meal. An endocrinologist, a forensic botanist and a short-order cook answer their question.

programme.title: Forensic Files: When the Dust Settled
programme.desc: Soon after organizing a workers' strike, a union official is executed in his home. Neither his wife nor anyone in the neighborhood hear any gunshots. It takes a forensic sound test, an electron microscope and a nightgown to explain why.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Welcome Intrusion
programme.desc: A man tells police he shot an intruder who had attacked and murdered his wife. The husband paints a tragic picture and is dubbed a hero. Four years later, forensic evidence leads police to re-examine the motives of this so-called hero.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The C-11 Squad

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death In The Delta

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Federal Offense
programme.desc: When there's a difficult case to crack  whether it involves drugs, arson, or weapons  the investigators and scientists of the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco and Firearms have the means to crack it.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Who Did This?

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Dead Man Falling

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Fall From Grace
programme.desc: Hikers come across a horrific scene: the corpse of a man left nude, beaten and bound in the mountain wilderness.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: With Friends Like This

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Blood On the Tracks
programme.desc: When an unsuspecting train conductor discovers a decapitated body on a lonely stretch of track, Lt. Joe Kenda must unravel the mystery of his death.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Make My Day

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Living Planet

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Cosmic Collisions
programme.desc: Space is vast, yet it is full of collisions. Gas and dust electrostatically flock together, and gravity takes over coalescing grains into rocks. Those rocks become boulders, then asteroids colliding again and again, striking planets and each other.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Gravity
programme.desc: Gravity keeps us on the ground and the planets in their orbits, yet we only notice it when it's not there. In space we cheat gravity; falling just as fast but missing the ground. Now this fundamental universal force is slowly giving up its secrets.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Interface

programme.desc: Når Sam og Freddie begge to vinner konkurransen for skolens beste skap, slir de nødt til å dele skap. Carly ber Spencer gi henne timer i billedkunst.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly utdelingen
programme.desc: Carly, Sam og Freddie holder en iCarly-galla for de beste bruker-bidragene i iCarly, og hyller pristagerne live på web-showet. Spencer verver europeiske badedraktmodeller for å hjelpe ham å lage premiestatuettene.

programme.title: iCarly: Tvillinger
programme.desc: Freddie prøver å bevise at Melanie, Sams tvillingesøster, er Sam i forkledning. Når Carly underviser Spencers nemesis, Chuck, prøver Spencer å overbevise henne om at Chuck er ond.

programme.title: iCarly: A date en pøbel del 2
programme.desc: Når Carly oppdager at hennes tøffe kjæreste Griffin samler på små Pee Wee Babies, må hun ta stilling til om hun holder ut å date en kar som har en kosedyrsamling. I mens forsøker Spencer å hjelpe Sam med å bli kvitt et mareritt.

programme.title: iCarly: iKamp mot Dingo
programme.desc: Dingo-kanalen har stjålet idéer fra iCarly, så Carly, Sam, Freddie og Spencer drar til Dingos Studio for å fortelle manusforfatterne hva de mener om det.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg tror de kysset
programme.desc: Da Sam kommer til å avsløre overfor Carly at hun og Freddie smugkysset, konfronterer Carly dem med hvorfor de ikke fortalte henne om det. Og Spencer underviser fanger i billedkunst i fengselet.

programme.title: iCarly: Kokkekamp
programme.desc: Når Carl, Sam og Freddie vinner over en berømt tv-kokk i en matlagningskonkurranse, vil ikke kokken lage mat mer og nekter å komme ut av soverommet sitt. Spencer prøver å oppfylle en fremtidsdrøm.

programme.title: Awkward: Now You See Me, Now I Don't
programme.desc: Årbøkene er kommet ut. Jenna depper over stikkordet under hennes bilde, men hva kommer Matty til å skrive i årboken hennes?

programme.title: Awkward: The Dis-Engagement Dinner
programme.desc: Jenna tvinges til å holde en fest for Tamara for å feire hennes feike forlovelse. Samtidig får Jenna vite en hemmelighet om Matty som sender henne ut på jakt etter sannheten.

programme.title: Awkward: Don't Dream It's Over
programme.desc: Når Tamara sier at Jenna ødelegger forhold, konfronterer Jenna ekskjærestene sine, med overraskende resultater.

programme.title: Awkward: The Big Reveal
programme.desc: Jenna vil avsløre sannheten for Matty, men vil hennes nære og kjære stoppe henne?

programme.title: Awkward: An Indecent Promposal
programme.desc: Elevene ber hverandre på ball, og Jenna får noen overraskende nyheter.

programme.title: Awkward: Say No To The Dress
programme.desc: Jenna har bestemt seg for å ha det perfekte ballet, men det star mange hinder i veien.

programme.title: Awkward: Reality Does Not Bite
programme.desc: Ballet byr på mange overraskelser.

programme.title: Awkward: The Graduates
programme.desc: Eksamensfesten kan bli ødelagt da Sadie Saxton ikke får lov til å gå og hente vitnemålet sitt.

programme.title: Awkward: Holding on and Letting Go
programme.desc: Alle prøver å få den siste kvelden på skolen til å bli noe spesielt.

programme.title: Awkward: I'm the Kind of Girl Who Found Her Voice in College
programme.desc: Jenna svever på toppen av verden da hun kommer hjem fra sitt første år på college, men hennes nye selvtillit rystes når hun oppdager at hun ikke er den eneste som har forandret seg.

programme.title: Awkward: WTF Happened Last Year?
programme.desc: Jenna avslører hva som hendte med henne og resten av gjengen i året som gikk - hva som var grunnen til isen som la seg mellom Matty og Jenna, hva som varmet forholdet mellom Sadie og Tamara og hvordan Jake og Lissa gjenfant romantikken.

programme.title: Mando Diao MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: Med gjesteartister som Ane Brun, Kristofer Greczula og Veera Pyykkö inntar Mando Diao MTV Unplugged-scenen. Pluto TV byr på en nedstrippet og intim konsert med Mando Diao fra deres nye album «Efter Solnedgången».

programme.title: Lenny Kravitz MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: In an intimate live performance, superstars demonstrate their skills with acoustic versions of their greatest hits. This episode features Lenny Kravitz unplugged.

programme.title: Alicia Keys MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: Alicia Keys performs Unplugged at the Brooklyn Academy of Music.

programme.title: Paul McCartney MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: MTV Unplugged,' world premiered this one hour performance with the legendary Paul McCartney. This performance was simulcast via the Global Satellite Network. Taped on January 25, 1991 at the Limehouse Studios in London.

programme.title: John Mellencamp MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: This one-hour episode with beloved American rocker John Mellencamp was taped in Los Angeles in April of 1992, and features a medley of Mellencamp hits, past and present.

programme.title: Detroiters: Dream Cruise
programme.desc: Når de ansatte truer med å slutte på grunn av manglende helseforsikring, forsøker Tim og Sam å samle inn pengene de skylder fra tidligere jobber. Deres innsats forvanskes av Detroits årlige 'Dream Cruise'-bilshow. Gjest er Cecily Strong.

programme.title: Detroiters: Husky Boys
programme.desc: Tims far - 'Big Hank' - kommer uventet tilbake fra galehuset under mistenkelige forhold. Tim og Sam sliter med en å skape et slagord for en varehus-reklame som henvender seg til store, sterke karer.

programme.title: Detroiters: Quick Rick Mahorn in Dearborn
programme.desc: Tim og Sam oppdager at Chrysler-sjefen de kjørte over har hatt det forferdelig siden. Etter å ha vært med i en av reklamene, får Piston-legenden Rick Mahorn skuespillerambisjoner. Gjester er Jason Sudeikis, Rick Mahorn og Richard Karn.

programme.title: Workaholics: Dry Guys
programme.desc: Gutta våkner opp i deres vrakede huset etter en natt med vill festing. De har forferdelig bakrus og bestemmer seg for å holde seg edru i en uke, men Adam er ikke helt med på idéen.

programme.title: Workaholics: Temp-Tress
programme.desc: Det er en ny deilig vikar på TelAmericorp. Adam, Anders og Blake finner det svært vanskelig å konsentrere seg i hennes nærvær. Deres selvkontroll blir satt på prøve.

programme.title: Workaholics: Heist School
programme.desc: Gutta bestemmer at de som skattebetalere har rett til å eie den lokale lekeplassens dragestatue. De stiller den ut foran huset, der den blir stjålet av noen high school-elever. Gutta går undercover for å få den tilbake.

programme.title: Workaholics: 6 Hours Till Hedonism II
programme.desc: Gutta har planlagt en kul reise til Thanksgiving, men de finner ut at Blake ikke har et gyldig pass. Det er plutselig ikke så gøy når de må vente i seks timer på å få et nytt eller avlyse deres tur til Hedonism II.

programme.title: Comedy Central Presents: Rachel Feinstein
programme.desc: Rachel Feinstein diskuterer hvor vanskelig det er å finne en mann som ikke har homofile tendenser, og sine følelser angående porno.

programme.title: Comedy Central Presents: Shane Mauss
programme.desc: Shane Mauss forteller om hullet i rumpa si, hvorfor sexprat er pinlig, og sine problemer med det metriske system.

programme.title: Comedy Central Presents: Mo Mandel
programme.desc: Mo Mandel diskuterer sin kulturarv som en jødisk bondeknøl, sin første gang hos en asiatisk massør, og det å være dritsur når man våkner.

programme.title: Comedy Central Presents: Iliza Shlesinger
programme.desc: Iliza Shlesinger snakker om kaldt vær og puertorikanere, og det å få bordhjørner i skrittet.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Non-Stop Party

programme.desc: Stan Lee har noen nye superhelter, og en gatesmart fyr mister sin street cred når han opplever en hjernefrysning. Og sist, men ikke minst, utvikler en mann en komplisert minnesanordning for å huske hvor han har parkert.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Slap-Ass: In Recovery
programme.desc: En baseballspiller slåss med sin avhengighet av rumpeklapsing, en mafioso tar hevn og Steve Urkel driver en mann til vanvidd.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!: Episode 1725
programme.desc: En helt absurd og sursøt uke treffer paradiset som en bombe. Røde knapper og anonyme telefoner skaper kaos på hotellet.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!: Episode 1726
programme.desc: Den mystiske knappen leverer en absurd kostymefest, og hotellet eksploderer i drama.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!: Episode 1727
programme.desc: Noen våkner med ængst. Og når den rosa telefonen ringer, må det legges nye planer.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!: Episode 1728
programme.desc: En heksedoktor sjekker inn på hotellet og nye par blir dannet. Et hemmelig oppdrag setter flere av gjestene i fare.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!: Episode 1729
programme.desc: Jentene drar på en dødelig utflukt hvor flere må reise hjem. Festen ender for noen i drama og hos andre i «forelskelse».

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!: Episode 1730
programme.desc: Ting må debriefes på frokosten, og en av jentene må ta et vanskelig valg. Hvor går Emil?

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 902
programme.desc: Amalie Snøløs drømmer om å kjøpe et oppussingsobjekt! Men har hun egentlig tid til det? Solfrid og André har spurt Hans Christian om hjelp til å finne drømmehuset, men ikke for enhver pris.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 903
programme.desc: Hanne kjøpte drømmeboligen som viste seg å være infisert av både rotter og skjeggkre. Etter sitt forrige bomkjøp håper hun at Hans Christian kan hjelpe. Og Christian skal kjøpe sin første leilighet.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 904
programme.desc: Positivitetsblogger Petter ønsker å bo nærmere sentrum, men klarer Karianne å finne den perfekte guttebula? Camilla og Jon Erik trenger mer plass og får hjelp av Hans Christian.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 905
programme.desc: Iselinn og Ron er helt uenige om hvor de vil bo. Klarer Karianne å løse en tilnærmet umulig oppgave? Gårdsguttene Kim og Ole Johnny er på jakt etter et idyllisk gårdsbruk med skog og egen strandlinje.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 906
programme.desc: Karianne får et viktig oppdrag med å hjelpe alenemamma Samia i hus før mammapermisjonen er over – men holder budsjettet? Hans Christian møter Johanna og Joakim som er på jakt etter drømmehagen.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1001
programme.desc: Ingrid bor på leilighetshotell med sine to barn, og er desperat etter å få en ny start, og skape et hjem sammen med familien. Småbarnsforeldrene Toril og Eivind vil ut av leiligheten sin i Oslo-gryta.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 628
programme.desc: Deltakerne kjemper hardt i lærlingkampen om å ikke bli andrelærling, men en går tapende ut og må møte en god venn i sesongens siste ordinære kokkekamp. Hvem står igjen som finalister når dagen er over?

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 629
programme.desc: Første dag i finaleuken! Deltakerne sparker i gang finaleuken med nok en lang og hektisk dag på kjøkkenet. Kjartan har store forventninger til finalistene og forventer høy standard på det som serveres.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 630
programme.desc: Et steg nærmere finalen for de gjenværende deltakerne! På dag to i finaleuken utfordrer Kjartan finalistenes smaksløker. Dagen avsluttes med at enda en finalist må reise hjem.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 631
programme.desc: Finalen nærmer seg med stormskritt! De gjenværende finalistene ønsker alle å stå i finalen, men i dag må de kommunisere godt med hverandre for å komme seg dit.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 632
programme.desc: Tre spente deltakere står klare for årets semifinale. Kjartan tester deltakerne i presisjon, teknikk og hurtighet, før den første finalisten kåres. Sesongens siste duell avgjør hvem som blir den siste finalisten.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 633
programme.desc: Finaledag på Camp Kulinaris! De tidligere deltakerne er tilbake! Dette til stor glede og motivasjon for de to finalistene. Det er duket for en hektisk og meget spennende finaledag. Hvem går seirende ut av årets sesong?

programme.title: Charterfeber
programme.desc: Familien fra Harstad er nok en gang på besøk på Gran Canaria. De får selskap av verdens gemeste fyr, Fred Åge og førstereisgutt Roger. Med er også Paradise Hotel-vennene Bendik Romeo, Lotte og Amalie.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 918
programme.desc: Gjennom ferien på Gran Canaria har Fred Åge prøvd å slå Sven Erik i en rekke konkurranser. Han gir ikke opp og kanskje blir det endelig hans tur til å vinne i dag?

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1020
programme.desc: Bjørge og Tove skal på kryddermarked, men det oppstår problemer. Tone og Charlett har en dag i hestens tegn. Danseparet Trond og Vivian drar på te-dans, mens Anne Berit og Eilert skal på drag show.

programme.title: Charterfeber
programme.desc: Gjengen fra Finnskogen setter kursen for “Norskeplassen”. Aslaug blir rørt til tårer av feiringen som sønnen Stein Are og onkel Erling varter opp med. Jan og Tina turen ut for karaoke.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 920
programme.desc: Det er siste dag på Gran Canaria for denne gang, og Svein har nok en sesong bak seg som Charter-Svein. Denne gang som kongen av Granka.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 907
programme.desc: Christian er ikke spesielt fornøyd med å dele hotellrom med moren, og jobber hardt for å få et eget rom med sjøutsikt.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 510
programme.desc: Ole, Gustav og Halvor pusser opp hver sin rorbu på Træna i Nordland. Her bobler konkurranseinstinktet opp til overflaten, da eierne skal kåre hvilken rorbu de liker best.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 310
programme.desc: Sesongens siste hytte ligger i vinterparadiset Geilo med utsikt til fantastiske Hallingskarvet. Gutta ønsker å gi den slite hytta en solid ansiksløftning, fornye kjøkkenet, samt utvide stuen.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 802
programme.desc: Gutta drar til avsidesliggende Ytre Fure på Stadlandet. Her skal de forvandle en gammel sveitservilla til et idyllisk og praktisk sommerhus. Halvor lærer Ole å legge tapet, og det skjer også et spennende prosjekt under det gamle fjøset.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 903
programme.desc: Ytterst på et svaberg ved Tjomsland i Larvik kommune ligger en hytte du knapt kan se. Her gjenbrukes mer enn vanlig, men hytta er likevel ikke til å kjenne igjen når uka er omme.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 504
programme.desc: Denne uka tar gutta fatt på en oppussing som eierne ikke har søkt om. På Værøy fyr utenfor Lofoten bruker de seks dager på en oppgave eierne tror vil ta fem til seks år.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 404
programme.desc: På Norges vestligste øy Utvær, ligger ei nydelig hytte som sårt trenger litt hjelp fra Halvor og gutta. Både ute- og innerom skal gjennom en stor forvandling.

programme.title: Luksusfellen: Episode 2505

programme.title: Luksusfellen: Episode 2506

programme.title: Luksusfellen

programme.title: Luksusfellen
programme.desc: Robin kaster bort alle pengene på dyre hobbyer. Det har akkurat blitt slutt med Madeleine fra forrige episode, og med sin skyhøye gjeld og heftige forbruk er den nye hverdagen vanskelig.

programme.title: Luksusfellen: Episode 2603

programme.title: Luksusfellen

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 301

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 302
programme.desc: Louise og Michael har vokst ut av sin lille leilighet i Århus og trenger mer plass. Paret gjør et kompromiss, og Louise står overfor sitt største mareritt i huset som ekspertene kjøper til dem.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 303

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Greater Copenhagen
programme.desc: Copenhagen and Skåne are a hot food destinations. Tareq visits Østergro, Denmark's first "rooftop farm" in the middle of Copenhagen, Eden in the new district Hyllie, Malmö and Häckeberga Castle where there will be wild boar for dinner.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Höganäs
programme.desc: The wild coast at Kullaberg in Skåne has a lot of culture and gastronomy to offer. Fantastic ceramics, vineyards and world-class ice cream. Tareq visits VikenTomater and cooks vegetarian ragù

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Karlstad
programme.desc: Tareq visits sunny Karlstad! Here, food is prepared by Vänern's shores and in Värmland's deep forests. Butter-fried Zander, crepes and cooking over an open fire are on the menu.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Best Of (Part 2)
programme.desc: Once again, Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Lund
programme.desc: In this episode, Tareq visits Lund, a thousand-year old city in southern Sweden. Lund is surrounded by the richest farmland in the country, and we explore nearby islands and meet entrepreneurs making highly-regarded local products.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Bornholm
programme.desc: Tareq sails out to Bornholm, a Danish island close to southern tip of Sweden. The islanders are fiercely self-sufficient and this attitude reflects in the huge number of food producers making products that are sold both locally and internationally.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Jokkmokk
programme.desc: Far above the Arctic Circle, Tareq explores the wild country around Jokkmokk. Here, the Sami people lived from what the land provides for thousands of years. This wild cuisine is as extreme as the weather here.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Åland
programme.desc: For hundreds of years, Åland’s shipping fleet was the envy of navies around the world, and their sea trade was encouraged by the seafood, grains and fruits that thrive on these islands. Tareq prepares recipes to reflect Åland’s unique cuisine.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Welcome Intrusion
programme.desc: A man tells police he shot an intruder who had attacked and murdered his wife. The husband paints a tragic picture and is dubbed a hero. Four years later, forensic evidence leads police to re-examine the motives of this so-called hero.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Within Arm's Reach
programme.desc: A police officer accused of killing his estranged wife insists she committed suicide. Investigators say it was murder — that it was physically impossible for the woman to have shot herself.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Private Thoughts
programme.desc: Firefighters find an entire family dead inside their home in an apparent murder-suicide, but there are several inconsistent clues in the rubble. Could ballistics, a time card and some secret audiotapes unravel the mystery?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Brotherhoods
programme.desc: Two men are murdered while sleeping in their beds. The next night, arson destroys a family planning clinic. Investigators wonder whether some shards of glass, paint chips and a chicken feather could link what appear to be two separate crimes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hair of the Dog
programme.desc: Investigators are baffled after finding a murder scene devoid of any physical evidence, but they suspect that the victim's dog had witnessed the crime. If so, forensic scientists would have to find some way to learn what the dog had seen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Breaking News
programme.desc: A young TV news producer is raped and murdered in her apartment. Police identify two suspects, but both are cleared of any wrongdoing. When the case stalls for more than a year, investigators turn to the Commonwealth of Virginia's DNA Databank.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All the World's a Stage
programme.desc: Police are dispatched to the scene of a shooting and discover the victim's husband is one of their own: a homicide detective who says his wife accidentally shot herself in the head.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Big Chill
programme.desc: For years, a woman suffered from what appeared to be the unpleasant side effects of lithium, a drug prescribed to treat bipolar disorder. When she died, investigators had to determine if her death was due to natural causes, suicide or murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bound for Jail
programme.desc: A woman is found dead in a ravine, and crucial evidence has been washed away by severe thunderstorms. Twice, the trail turns cold. Almost 20 years later, an old hat and a chip of stainless steel brings the killer to justice.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sphere of Influence
programme.desc: When an 11-year-old girl disappears from a remote Alaska town, investigators wonder if she has been attacked by a bear or become lost in the dense woods. Eventually, they realize that neither assumption is true.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Small Town Terror
programme.desc: In a small Ohio community, an elderly woman and a teenaged boy disappeared. Because they vanished within hours of each other, police believed the cases were linked. But they didn't know how.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Brotherhood of Hate
programme.desc: In 1984, a tragic murder led agents into the frightening world of domestic terrorism. Law enforcement vowed to dismantle the violent faction that claimed responsibility.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Mission
programme.desc: When a family was murdered in Arkansas, it seemed like an isolated event. But soon the crime was revealed to be part of an ever-widening circle of violence that defined a new age of domestic terrorism.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Living In Terror
programme.desc: Terrorism: Thanks to new technology and, perhaps, the approaching millennium, terrorism is a growing international threat. The Oklahoma City explosion and the bombing of the World Trade Center are just two of the incidents of this growing problem.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Women Who Kill
programme.desc: Men don't have a monopoly on murder, but it's still extraordinary when women kill. Though female killers are as deadly as males, they choose less violent methods.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Soldier Stories
programme.desc: This show profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts as they work to tell the stories of the young men who went to war (from the French and Indian war to Vietnam) and never came back.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Infallible Witness
programme.desc: Investigators are always on the cutting edge of new forensic techniques that can help them solve cases more accurately. An experimental "brain fingerprinting" technique has already won the acquittal of a police officer accused of a drug charge.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Traces Of Guilt
programme.desc: Sometimes the scales of justice are balanced by just a few milligrams of evidence: a couple of fibers, a tooth filling, or a smudge on a piece of tape. The biggest cases are often solved by the smallest clues.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Who Did This?
programme.desc: Who’s responsible for toddler Noel's well-being? Everyone may deny the allegations, but someone knows what happened, and Steve is getting answers!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: My Boyfriend Beat Up My Mom
programme.desc: Kendra is on a mission to save herself from her toxic boyfriend Chris. At 17, Kendra is pregnant with his sixth child. Kendra has tried almost everything including kicking him out of their house, but he not only argued back but assaulted Kendra as well.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve Over the Edge
programme.desc: Sheroya is 17 and struggling to raise 2 kids while trying to party all the time. Her boyfriend Malcolm frequently cheats and verbally abuses her. Steve’s got a lot of work ahead with this couple, but will either of them wake up?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: You Failed 5 Times?
programme.desc: Did Everett touch his girlfriend Michelle’s daughter? Her ex Robert says that his 7-year-old daughter said so. Everett will take a lie detector test to disprove it! Don’t miss these shocking results!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I’m Not the Man You Think I Am
programme.desc: Sean says his wife has made him so angry that he’s put her in the hospital over 10 times. Sean’s also got a secret of his own — he is really a she! Can Steve help Sean iron out his issues?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Real Teens: Real Topics
programme.desc: Steve’s hosting another teen girl town hall to address critical issues all teen girls could face, including drug use, physical abuse, and online predators. No question is off limits!

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Make My Day

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: .357 Magnum

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Rearview Mirror
programme.desc: When a retired military man runs over a pedestrian, it’s up to Lt. Joe Kenda to determine if it was bad brakes or bad intent.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Shot Through the Heart
programme.desc: 15yr old Chuck returns home from school to find his mother, Betty Limbrick, shot dead on the floor. Evidence points to a robbery gone wrong, but Kenda uncovers a plot almost too shocking to believe.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Blood Sisters
programme.desc: The bullet-ridden bodies of two sisters are found in a suburban house that’s littered with mysterious clues. Joe Kenda learns that the two unassuming young mothers shared an explosive secret.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Victim Zero

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 1: The Solar System
programme.desc: This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Seeds for Doubt
programme.desc: In 2002, a small community in upstate New York was devastated when Patty Wlasiuk died in a truck accident. But burdock seed pods found in her hair and on her clothes indicated that this was no accident — it was cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Saving Face
programme.desc: When a woman disappeared without a trace, there were two possible explanations: kidnapping or murder. Careful investigation, a forensic artist and DNA profiling enabled police to find a single suspect, who was known to prey upon vulnerable women.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Northern Exposure
programme.desc: Alaskan hikers discover a body wrapped in sheets which were edged in orange stitching. Investigators find a tuft of red carpet fibers clinging to the sheet — threads of evidence which lead them straight to the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Silk Stalkings
programme.desc: Prompted by news of a flight attendant's brutal murder, the son of a previous victim contacts police. Both murders have similar MOs, and biological evidence proves that these were serial killings.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fishing for the Truth
programme.desc: A two-man shrimp boat sinks when a fast-moving, violent storm strikes the Louisiana coast. The captain drowns, but the deckhand is rescued fourteen hours later. The crewman is hailed as a hero — until the captain's body is discovered.

programme.title: Forensic Files: For Love or Money
programme.desc: When a wealthy real estate tycoon goes missing, it appears to be foul play. In his will, he leaves instructions in case he should die under violent circumstances — which were carried out after a hiker comes across his bullet-ridden skull.

programme.title: Forensic Files: South of the Border
programme.desc: The murder of an American tourist in a Mexican resort draws law enforcement resources on both sides of the border. At first glance, the motive appears to be robbery, but careful analysis of the forensic evidence points to something more sinister.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Stake-Out
programme.desc: Police are led on a wild goose chase when the wife of a prominent banker is kidnapped. An entomologist's unexpected discovery leads to a new suspect — and the realization that ordinary office equipment can leave extraordinary clues.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Walking Terror
programme.desc: A neighbor watched as a man stabbed his wife, pushed her into the swimming pool and held her head under water. The husband, however, had no recollection of the crime. A jury would have to decide between evidence and the mysteries of the mind.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Marked for Life
programme.desc: It would take 46 years, handwriting analysis and new fingerprint technology to solve the 1957 murders of two California police officers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Plastic Puzzle
programme.desc: A man riding a bicycle was fatally injured in what police believed to be a hit-and-run accident. Tiny clues found at the scene created a picture of the vehicle which struck him and led police to its driver.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Barry Bostwick

programme.title: iCarly: Kokkekamp
programme.desc: Når Carl, Sam og Freddie vinner over en berømt tv-kokk i en matlagningskonkurranse, vil ikke kokken lage mat mer og nekter å komme ut av soverommet sitt. Spencer prøver å oppfylle en fremtidsdrøm.

programme.title: iCarly: Rektor kampen
programme.desc: Når Carly, Sam og Freddie får rektor Franklin sparket, overtar miss Briggs og mr. Howard ledelsen og innfører strenge regler. Og Spencer leier en gammel rodeostjerne til å lære ham å ri på en mekanisk okse.

programme.title: iCarly: iSpeed Date
programme.desc: Så mange gutter dukker opp til 'ta Carly med på fest'-konkurransen, at Carly, Sam og Freddie må benytte speed-dating for å møte dem alle sammen. Spencer følger et merkelig treningsprogram fra en ny app.

programme.title: iCarly: Stjernehjelp
programme.desc: Når Carly, Sam og Freddie skal lage en musikkvideo til en popstjernes comeback, oppdager de at popstjernen er ute av form og talentløs. Og Spencer oppdager at kvinnen han dater er Gibbys mor.

programme.title: iCarly: Livredderen
programme.desc: Når Freddie redder livet til Carly, forelsker Carly seg i ham. Sam og Spencer kjemper mot hverandre i et painball-spill som heter Assassin.

programme.title: iCarly: Lewberts tapte kjærlighet
programme.desc: Når gjengen oppdager at Lewbert engang var en lykkelig ung mann som var forlovet med en vakker kvinne, setter de seg fore å gjenforene det adskilte paret.

programme.title: iCarly: Missekonkurransen
programme.desc: Sam avslører overfor Carly og Freddie at hun deltok i skjønnhetskonkurranser som liten. Da hun finner ut at hennes rival skal konkurrere i Seattle, overbeviser hun Carly om å stille opp mot henne.

programme.title: iCarly: Vi avlyser ikke
programme.desc: Etter at Sam plutselig må i fengsel, lover Carly og Freddie dyrt og hellig å ikke avlyse nettshowet ettersom faren hennes skal se det. Carly ber Spencer om hjelp, men det blir vanskelig, for han skal på date.

programme.title: iCarly: Vi avlyser ikke
programme.desc: En eksentrisk millionær ber Carly og vennene hennes om å sende det første nettshowet fra det ytre rom, så de må prøves ut for en romreise. Imens besøker en merkelig liten pike Spencer hjemme i leiligheten.

programme.title: iCarly: Freddie flytter ut
programme.desc: Freddie bestemmer seg for å flytte ut av leiligheten sin etter at moren hans har gjort ham flau. Carly, Sam og Freddie starter et firma og spesialiserer seg på bilder av kjæledyr.

programme.title: iCarly: iBeat the Heat
programme.desc: Når en hetebølge rammer Seattle og strømmen går, kommer Spencer til unnsetning med et norsk klimaanlegg.

programme.title: Awkward: WTF Happened Last Year?
programme.desc: Jenna avslører hva som hendte med henne og resten av gjengen i året som gikk - hva som var grunnen til isen som la seg mellom Matty og Jenna, hva som varmet forholdet mellom Sadie og Tamara og hvordan Jake og Lissa gjenfant romantikken.

programme.title: Awkward: The Friend Connection
programme.desc: Jenna unngår et nytt forhold for å få kontakt med dem hun jobber sammen med. I mens holder Tamara et chict bursdagsselskap for Sadie - som etterlater mer enn en festdeltager i slett festhumør.

programme.title: Awkward: Best Friends For Never
programme.desc: I et forsøk på å gjøre Idea Bin til et hyggeligere sted for henne selv, spleiser Jenna Tamara med en praktikant, men oppdager raskt at å jobbe med venner raskt kan bli en katastrofe.

programme.title: Awkward: Fireworks
programme.desc: Jake sikrer Jenna og Tamara skift på country-klubben den 4. juli, men Sullys planer om en etterfest på golfbanen resulterer i dramatiske fyrverkeri.

programme.title: Awkward: Digging Deep
programme.desc: Etter moroa på 4. juli, fortsetter Jenna og Matty å fyre opp under vennskapet ved å holde fest for Jake - i det minste inntil Jennas nyeste Idea Bin-post truer med å avsløre alt.

programme.title: Awkward: Girls Gone Viral
programme.desc: Jenna prøver å velge mellom suksess hos Idea Bin og sitt vennskap med Matty. Jake opplever et uventet intimt møte, og Sadie og Sergio driver plutselig og sparrer mer enn noen gang.

programme.title: Awkward: Misadventures in Babysitting
programme.desc: Jenna melder seg som barnevakt og mottar uventet hjelp av Matty. I mens får Lissa vite hva som er hemmeligheten ved å være en Palos Hills-mamma, og Tamara og Sadie får mer en nok på en rik tenårings strandselskap.

programme.title: Awkward: Living in Sin
programme.desc: Jenna tar forholdet med Luke ett nivå opp og Tamaras gjeld kommer tilbake og biter henne i halen.

programme.title: Awkward: Home Again, Home Again
programme.desc: En krangel med Luke presser Jenna til å bli med på leirgjenforeningen og dermed mot å gjenoppta kontakten med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: Second Chances
programme.desc: Luke hjelper Jenna til å få et viktig møte på SCU, Tamara er ærlig mot Patrick om sine pengeproblemer, og Matty får Sadies hjelp til å komme inn igjen i varmen hos Lacey.

programme.title: Awkward: Happy Campers, Happier Trails
programme.desc: Jenna må velge mellom et viktig SCU-event og leirgjenforeningen, noe som fører til et enda større valg: Luke eller Matty. Men hun er ikke alene, for både Jake, Tamara og Lissa må ta avgjørende valg de også.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Bitch
programme.desc: I denne seriepremierer av komiprogrammet prøver Jordan Peele og Keegan Michael Key å si et forbudt ord om deres kvinner, Lil Wayne venner seg til livet bak lås og slå, og president Obama uttrykker hva han egentlig føler.

programme.title: Key & Peele: East Bowl Rap / West Bowl Rap

programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan diskuterer hvem som er mest svart, og å være den eneste svarte på en fest. Sketsjer inkluderer Tea Party som oppdager et nytt håp, hærens ververe som tenker annerledes, og Bobby McFerrin som duellerer mot Michael Winslow.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Country Music

programme.desc: Dave asks contestants how much they know about black American culture.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Tosh.0 March 19, 2013 - The Illusion
programme.desc: The Illusion interns for Tosh.0, Daniel battles a homophobic rapper, and prankster Todd Glass dresses up as a cop.

programme.title: Tosh.0: LP Theories
programme.desc: Daniels nye kvinneparfyme kommer ut, han tilbringer tid med sin yndlingskomiker oppkalt etter en rotgrønnsak og noen ufølsomme collegejenter får oppreisning på nettet.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Plus-Size Model
programme.desc: Daniel presenterer oss for vår gærne nabo i nord og løser alt som er galt med USA - og dessuten får en model med et enormt hjerte (og stort alt annet) sin oppreisning på nettet.

programme.title: Tosh.0: BK Chicken Fries
programme.desc: Daniel lærer hvilke av hans private deler som er brannfarlige og gir bort ting gratis, og en entusiastisk mann som er glad i barnemat, får oppreisning på nettet.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Hey, Baby Girl
programme.desc: Daniel hjelper Bill Gates med å skape et produkt som folk liker å bruke og lærer Georgia litt om borgerrettigheter. Dessuten får en gutt med bar overkropp oppreisning på nettet.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Fired For Being Too Hot
programme.desc: Daniel kommer "sex" tilbake i sextrakassering, gjør deg enda mer paranoid om å bo på hotell og hyller trær før Arbor Day og "420". Og en kvinne som ble sparket fordi hun var for pen, får oppreisning på nettet.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Pussy Power
programme.desc: Daniel snakker med et barn som har sugermerker over hele kroppen, sender masse penger til en fremmed på nettet og gjør et CeWEBrity-portrett.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Ready to Mingle
programme.desc: Daniel vil bli invitert til skoleball, avslører alt om sommerens filmer og en produktiv og psykotisk artist, Tonetta, får en oppreisning.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Nerf Hoops (30 for 30.0)
programme.desc: Daniel gjør sin afrikanske etterfølger mer avstumpet og vurderer å begå selvmord. I tillegg får verdens beste Nerf-dunker oppreisning.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Furries Kid
programme.desc: I høstpremieren avslører Daniel sitt mest vågale klesvalg så langt, redder en furry fra et krisesenter og får en unik treningsøkt.

programme.title: Jeff Ross Presents: Roast Battle III
programme.desc: Mark Normand and Kurt Metzger battle it out, and NBA star Blake Griffin takes on Roastmaster General Jeff Ross.

programme.title: Jeff Ross Presents: Roast Battle II

programme.title: The Roast of Flavor Flav

programme.title: The Roast of James Franco
programme.desc: I hver episode av 'The Roast of' blir en berømt person roastet og harselert med av venner og fiender. Det er James Franco sin tur til å ta plass i kjendissetet i den nyeste episoden av The Comedy Central Roast.

programme.title: Jeff Ross Presents: Roast Battle III
programme.desc: Jeff Ross, Nikki Glaser and Anthony Jeselnik must decide who has the harshest burns in battles featuring Joe List, Sarah Tollemache and the Sklar Brothers.
